result.instructions: Tools for Paidnice, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are overdue by more than 30 days, and who owns each contact?"; "Show the late fee and reminder actions that failed this week and why."; "What did customers reply by email or SMS about invoices in the last 7 days?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Paidnice data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run paidnice_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run paidnice_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run paidnice_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. paidnice_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: paidnice_get_organisation
tools.title: Get organisation
tools.description: Get the Paidnice organisation behind the token: legal and display name, the connected accounting system (Xero or QuickBooks Online) and whether it is connected. Good first call. API: GET /organisation.

tools.name: paidnice_get_organisation_summary
tools.title: Get organisation summary
tools.description: Get the organisation's receivables summary (totals and counts of overdue and unpaid amounts as Paidnice reports them). API: GET /organisation/summary.

tools.name: paidnice_list_users
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the team members of the organisation (id, email, name). Use the ids as the userId of the assignee tools. API: GET /users.

tools.name: paidnice_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the customers (contacts) the organisation invoices, newest first. Use search for a name, account number or contact person email. Filter by promise to pay, invoice query or payment plan status. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for more. API: GET /contacts.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous page's nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

search.description: Search by name, account number or contact person email.

tools.name: paidnice_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get one customer (contact) with its contact persons, group, assigned team member and, when asked, its promises to pay, invoice queries and payment plans. API: GET /contact/{id}.

tools.name: paidnice_check_contact_policies
tools.title: Check contact policies
tools.description: Show which credit control policies Paidnice would run for a customer and why each one runs or is skipped. Read only: it does not send anything. API: GET /contact/{id}/policy-checks.

tools.name: paidnice_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List the sales invoices, ordered by due date (earliest first). Defaults to unpaid invoices. Filter by customer (contactId), status (unpaid, overdue, paid, all), due date range (yyyy-mm-dd), search text or promise to pay / query / plan status. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for more. API: GET /invoices.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous page's nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

contactId.description: Only invoices of this contact id.

search.description: Search text (invoice number, reference or customer name).

dueBefore.description: Due on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

dueAfter.description: Due on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: paidnice_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by its Paidnice id (a UUID from paidnice_list_invoices, not the invoice number): amounts, due date, status, contact, assigned team member and, when asked, promises, queries and plans. API: GET /invoice/{id}.

id.description: Paidnice invoice id (a UUID), from paidnice_list_invoices. Not the invoice number.

tools.name: paidnice_check_invoice_policies
tools.title: Check invoice policies
tools.description: Show which credit control policies Paidnice would run for an invoice and why each one runs or is skipped. Read only: it does not send anything. API: GET /invoice/{id}/policy-checks.

id.description: Paidnice invoice id (a UUID), from paidnice_list_invoices. Not the invoice number.

tools.name: paidnice_list_actions
tools.title: List actions
tools.description: List what Paidnice scheduled, sent, skipped or failed (reminders, late fees, statements, SMS, escalations and so on), newest first, with status, run dates and any error. Filter by contact, invoice, status or type. API: GET /actions.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous page's nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

contactId.description: Only actions for this contact id.

invoiceId.description: Only actions for this invoice id (UUID).

tools.name: paidnice_list_notes
tools.title: List notes
tools.description: List collection notes written by team members, newest first, for a contact or an invoice. API: GET /notes.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous page's nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

contactId.description: Only notes for this contact id.

invoiceId.description: Only notes for this invoice id (UUID).

tools.name: paidnice_list_inbound_sms
tools.title: List inbound SMS
tools.description: List SMS replies that customers sent back, newest first, with the matched contact and action when Paidnice found one. API: GET /inbound/sms.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous page's nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: paidnice_list_inbound_email
tools.title: List inbound email
tools.description: List email replies that customers sent back, newest first, with sender, subject, the reply text Paidnice extracted and the matched contact. API: GET /inbound/email.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous page's nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: paidnice_list_stripe_payments
tools.title: List Stripe payments
tools.description: List payments taken through Stripe on the customer portal, newest first, with status, amounts, fees and the invoices each payment paid. Filter by contact, invoice, status or date range (yyyy-mm-dd). API: GET /stripe-payments.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous page's nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

contactId.description: Only payments of this contact id.

invoiceId.description: Only payments for this invoice id (UUID).

tools.name: paidnice_update_contact_assignee
tools.title: Assign contact
tools.description: Assign a customer (contact) to a team member, by userId from paidnice_list_users or by email, or unassign it with userId null. Only the contact changes; its invoices keep their own assignees. Writes to Paidnice. API: PUT /contact/{id}/assignee.

userId.description: Team member id from paidnice_list_users. Pass null to unassign. Send userId or email, not both.

email.description: Team member email instead of userId (case insensitive). Send userId or email, not both.

tools.name: paidnice_update_invoice_assignee
tools.title: Assign invoice
tools.description: Assign an invoice to a team member, by userId from paidnice_list_users or by email, or unassign it with userId null. The assigned team member is notified, as when assigning in the app. Writes to Paidnice. API: PUT /invoice/{id}/assignee.

id.description: Paidnice invoice id (a UUID), from paidnice_list_invoices. Not the invoice number.

userId.description: Team member id from paidnice_list_users. Pass null to unassign. Send userId or email, not both.

email.description: Team member email instead of userId (case insensitive). Send userId or email, not both.
